title: Two Qwen vision models, two ways to think
summary:
New vision and text models arrived, older image models resurfaced, and API errors became rather more honest.

Qwen vision moved off a retired endpoint. `qwen-vision` ultimately landed on the non-reasoning Qwen3 VL 30B Instruct variant, while the new `qwen-vision-pro` uses the 235B Thinking variant. Both accept images and support tools.

GPT-5.4 Mini and Mistral Small 4 were added with image input and tool support. Existing Mistral aliases moved to Small 3.2; Llama 4 Scout gained tool support, and DeepSeek V4 Flash became eligible for free-tier use. Several listed context windows changed with the model routes.

Seedream v4.0 and v4.5 Pro were made discoverable again, alongside the still-recommended seedream5. Enter added model-description tooltips and corrected its NEW labels to reflect a model’s first seven days. The community catalog also added PromptArt, a Telegram image bot with style presets.

highlights.title: Two Qwen vision options
highlights.text: Use `qwen-vision` for non-reasoning image-and-text tasks, or the new `qwen-vision-pro` for the larger thinking model. Both support tools. [Explore qwen-vision-pro](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen-vision-pro).

highlights.title: Mistral Small 4 added
highlights.text: `mistral-4` accepts text and images, supports tools, and has a 262,144-token context window. The existing `mistral` aliases have also moved to Small 3.2. [Explore mistral-4](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mistral-4).

highlights.title: GPT-5.4 Mini added
highlights.text: `gpt-5.4-mini` accepts text and images, supports tools, and has a 400,000-token context window. `gpt-5-mini` and the new `openai-mini` alias point to it. [Explore GPT-5.4 Mini](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-5.4-mini).

highlights.title: Llama Scout gains tools
highlights.text: Llama 4 Scout now supports tool calls. Its listed context window is 327,680 tokens after the route change. [Explore Llama 4 Scout](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama-4-scout).

highlights.title: Seedream classics resurface
highlights.text: Seedream v4.0 and v4.5 Pro are discoverable in the image-model list and dashboard again. Both remain paid-only; seedream5 remains the recommended current version. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Embedding health in view
highlights.text: The model monitor adds an Embedding health card and filter, plus a sortable status column for spotting degraded or offline models. [Open the model monitor](https://model-monitor.pollinations.ai).
